results.title: طقس الجمعة.. أمطار رعدية ورياح مثيرة للأتربة على 8 مناطق
results.description:
أعلن المركز الوطني للأرصاد، تفاصيل حالة الطقس المتوقعة اليوم الجمعة، في السعودية، منبها من أمطار رعدية ورياح مثيرة للأتربة على أجزاء من 8 مناطق.

حسب بيان الأرصاد؛ لا تزال الفرصة مهيأة لهطول أمطار رعدية متوسطة إلى غزيرة تؤدي إلى جريان السيول مصحوبة بزخات من البرد على أجزاء من مناطق جازان، عسير، الباحة، وتكون خفيفة إلى متوسطة على أجزاء من مناطق مكة المكرمة، المدينة المنورة ونجران.

حالة الطقس المتوقعة ليوم #الجمعة 2026/9/18م
https://t.co/MkZ9zMZOXg#نحيطكم_بأجوائكم pic.twitter.com/pUw3LfxYak

— المركز الوطني للأرصاد (NCM) (@NCMKSA) September 17, 2026

حالتا #البحر_الأحمر و #الخليج_العربي ليوم #الجمعة 2026/9/18م#نحيطكم_بأجوائكم pic.twitter.com/wR2PJ9pLg4

results.title: تحطم مفاجئ لمقاتلة F-16 في ميشيغن
results.description: تحطمت مقاتلة أميركية من طراز «F-16» في ولاية ميشيغن، خلال مهمة تدريبية روتينية قرب مدينة ترافيرس سيتي، فيما تمكن الطيار من القفز من الطائرة والنجاة، وفق ما أعلن الحرس الوطني الجوي في ولاية تكساس، الخميس.وأوضح الحرس الوطني، في منشور عبر «فيسبوك»، أن الطائرة التابعة له تعرضت للحادث أثناء تنفيذ المهمة، مشيرًا إلى أن الطيار خرج منها بأمان، بينما بدأت الجهات المختصة تحقيقًا للوقوف على ملابسات الواقعة وأسباب التحطم.وبالتزامن مع الحادث، أعلنت السلطات المحلية تفعيل قرار بإخلاء منطقة تمتد لمسافة نحو 1.6 كيلومتر حول موقع سقوط الطائرة، من دون الكشف عن تفاصيل إضافية بشأن الإجراءات المتخذة أو وجود أضرار أخرى.من جانبه، قال السيناتور عن ولاية ميشيغن غاري بيترز، عبر منصة «إكس»، إنه يتابع تطورات الحادث عن كثب، ويعمل على الحصول على مزيد من المعلومات بشأن الواقعة.

results.title: AsiaWorld-Expo Invites Expression of Interest for Strategic Venue Alliances
results.description: Global Brands Invited to Shape Hong Kong's Next Iconic Destination for World-Class Events HONG KONG , Sept. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AsiaWorld-Expo (AWE) yesterday announced an invitation for global corporations and brands to submit Expression of Interest (EOIs) for the naming right and strategic brand partnerships for the flagship indoor multipurpose Super Arena at AWE Phase 2, marking another significant milestone in the development of AWE Phase 2. AWE welcomes forward-looking partners to join this landmark initiative and help create Hong Kong's next world-class destination for major events. Chief Executive Officer of Airport Authority Hong Kong (AAHK) and Chairman of AsiaWorld-Expo (AWE), Mrs Vivian Cheung (centre), AWE Board Member Ms Cissy Chan (second left), together with AWE Chief Executive Officer Ms Irene Chan (second right), Chief Strategy Officer Ms Enid Low (far left) and Chief Operating Officer Ms Dorothy Tan (far right) invite interested parties to submit EOIs for strategic venue alliances. Purpose-Built for World-Class Events Development of AWE Phase 2 is progressing at full pace, with construction targeted for completion by the end of 2028, and it will form an integral part of SKYTOPIA, the Airport City development of Hong Kong International Airport (HKIA). At its heart will be Hong Kong's largest indoor multipurpose arena, with a capacity of more than 20,000 spectators, purposefully planned to meet the professional requirements of international productions and major events. The Super Arena will feature tiered seating arranged around the venue, delivering an immersive 360-degree audiovisual experience. Its highly flexible layout will support a range of configurations, including centre-stage and end-stage formats, making it ideal for international performances, major events and elite sporting competitions. The arena will also feature 30 VIP s uites, offe ring premium hospitality, dedicated catering services and priority access. These exclusive facilities will enable spectators and corporate guests to enjoy exceptional events in comfort and privacy. During the initial research stage, AWE consulted industry stakeholders to gain an in-depth understanding of event requirements and market trends, ensuring that the plan responds to market needs and secures broad industry support. The Super Arena will feature 30 VIP suites, and offering premium hospitality, dedicated catering services and priority access. Seamlessly connected to Phase 1, AWE Phase 2 will further drive the transformation of the wider waterfront precinct. Upon completion, AWE's exhibition space will increase from approximately 70,000 sqm to 100,000 sqm. The masterplan will flexibly connect the venues and indoor and outdoor spaces across both phases. Organisers will be able to integrate exhibitions, conventions, sporting events, live entertainment and public experiences to meet diverse event requirements, moving beyond the conventional single-format event model. The extensive outdoor spaces linking the venues will become more than circulation routes, with the flexibility to transform into markets, performance and sporting spaces, food and lifestyle zones, and interactive brand activation areas. Responding to the global trend towards festivalisation, immersive experiences and cross-sector integration, AWE Phase 2 will incorporate festival elements into its venue planning and event design, enabling content to flow seamlessly between indoor and outdoor spaces. An event may begin with a conference, exhibition or competition, extend into outdoor dining, leisure and community activities, and culminate in a concert or celebration inside the Super Arena. Across a diverse range of interconnected spaces, organisers will be able to create cohesive event journeys that unfold from day to night. By integrating content, experiences and spaces, this forward-looking approach will further strengthen Hong Kong's competitiveness as a premier destination for mega events while establishing a new landmark for the city's events and MICE sectors. As an integral part of SKYTOPIA, AWE Phase 2 will generate even stronger synergies with the surrounding entertainment, arts, hospitality, retail, dining and tourism facilities. Together with the first phase of Airport Bay Marina, scheduled for completion in 2028, and the planned autonomous transportation systems linking SKYTOPIA with the Hong Kong Port of the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge (HZMB) and Tung Chung, these developments will further strengthen the area's connectivity by sea, land and air. Collectively, they will help create a world-class integrated destination, offering visitors more convenient, diverse and enriching event experiences. AWE Phase 2 upper Arena will accommodate more than 20,000 spectators. A Dual Gateway to Global Markets and the Greater Bay Area Located next to Hong Kong International Airport, AWE benefits from direct access to a leading international aviation hub connecting more than 220 destinations worldwide and placing half of the world's population within a five-hour flight. The expanded Terminal 2 (T2) will further enhance passenger capacity and cross-boundary connectivity. At the heart of the GBA, AWE connects businesses with a dynamic market of 87 million people through the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge, Airport Express and extensive cross-boundary transport network. Its direct access from the airport makes AWE a key gateway for international visitors and a major events hub, offering brands a compelling platform to engage high-value audiences across the GBA and global markets. A Premier Brand Platform Unlocking the Potential of the Mega-event Economy Upon completion of AWE Phase 2, AWE will further leverage the ability of major events to attract audiences, stimulate visitor spending and command international attention. Partner brands will gain access to a broader range of innovative collaboration and exposure opportunities, enabling them to integrate meaningfully across diverse events and visitor experiences. Beyond venue naming rights, partners may enjoy premium hospitality offerings, including dedicated VIP entrances, priority access, bespoke catering, corporate entertainment and interactive brand experiences, creating distinctive and memorable event journeys for clients and business partners. AWE hosts hundreds of major exhibitions and conferences, international concerts, sporting competitions and live entertainment experiences throughout the year, attracting business and leisure travellers from Hong Kong, the GBA and around the world. Brand exposure extends beyond the event itself and the physical venue, encompassing the entire visitor journey, from ticket purchase and travel planning to arrival, participation, post-event sharing and related spending. The strategic venue alliance, including venue naming and branded content, may be integrated across a broad range of touchpoints, including ticketing platforms, event promotions, social media, on-site experiences and corporate hospitality. This integrated approach will translate the visitor traffic, spending power and attention generated by each major event into sustained brand value, deeper customer engagement and new commercial opportunities. Partner brands will benefit not only from the events themselves, but also from the wider spending and engagement opportunities created before and after each event, positioning them as an integral part of the world-class event experience. Ms Irene Chan, Chief Executive Officer of AsiaWorld-Expo, said: "AWE Phase 2 represents far more than an expansion of the venue; it marks a new milestone for Hong Kong's events industry. Its flagship Super Arena will bring together world-class events, global audiences and leading brands, serving as a vital platform connecting Hong Kong, the GBA and international markets. We invite leading global brands to forge long-term strategic partnerships with us, seize the significant opportunities arising from Hong Kong's mega-event economy, and take off with us as we create a new landmark destination for world-class events." AWE now invites corporations with international market influence and a long-term vision for brand development to submit EOIs for the naming rights and strategic venue alliances for the flagship indoor multipurpose Super Arena at AWE Phase 2. Interested parties are encouraged to propose innovative partnership concepts and collaborate with AWE to unlock greater brand and commercial value from major events, opening a new chapter for Hong Kong's events industry. Details of the EOI can be found via the webpage: https://www.asiaworld-expo.com/en-us/about-us/phase-2 Download hi-res photos: https://www2.asiaworld-expo.com/2026/PressRelease/Phase2EOI.zip

results.title: 2026 World Manufacturing Convention Opens Sept. 20 in Hefei
results.description: "Made in Anhui" Takes the Global Stage HEFEI, China , Sept. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The 2026 World Manufacturing Convention will bring global business leaders, government officials and technology experts to Hefei, Anhui Province, from September 20 to 23 for four days of business engagement, technology showcases and discussions on the future of manufacturing. Held under the theme "Intelligent Manufacturing for a Better Future," the convention will feature an opening ceremony and keynote addresses, business-matching sessions spanning key industrial and supply chains, investment and project meetings, the release of major industry reports, and exhibitions highlighting the latest manufacturing technologies and achievements. Organizers have identified 946 potential partnership projects to date, representing more than RMB 400 billion in combined investment. More than 1,000 prominent guests from around the world are expected to attend, according to the World Manufacturing Convention Executive Committee Office. They will include foreign political leaders and ministerial-level officials; representatives of the guest country of honor and international partner provinces, states and cities; diplomatic and consular officials based in China; and heads of international organizations. The convention will also welcome more than 500 international delegates, including C-suite executives representing Fortune Global 500 companies and other multinationals, among them Merck, Mitsubishi Electric and Air Liquide. The United Kingdom will serve as this year's guest country of honor, while more than 40 companies from the United States, France, Russia and other countries will participate as exhibitors. A series of international business programs will connect Chinese and overseas companies, with sessions devoted to the international expansion of small and medium-sized enterprises, cross-border industrial and supply-chain partnerships, China-Europe manufacturing cooperation, and the future of industry in China and France. Dedicated programs will also feature the guest country of honor and Anhui's international partner provinces, states and cities. By bringing together companies and resources from across the industrial value chain, the convention aims to translate Anhui's manufacturing strengths into new commercial partnerships and investment opportunities. Provincial delegations have also promoted the event and pursued potential projects in Germany, Morocco and other international markets. The program will spotlight growth sectors including smart and connected electric, plug-in hybrid and fuel-cell vehicles, advanced information technologies and artificial intelligence, along with emerging fields such as quantum technologies, embodied AI and biomanufacturing. Leading scientists and industry experts from China and abroad will examine advances in these technologies and the trends expected to drive the next wave of industrial transformation. Among the major industry publications to be released are the Annual Report on the Development of the Industrial Base (2025–2026) and Manufacturing Digital Transformation Capabilities 2026 . The reports will provide data, analysis and practical insights for manufacturers and policymakers worldwide. This year's program comprises four flagship events, six major project and business-matching events, and 21 specialized programs. Flagship activities will include the opening ceremony, keynote addresses and an official tour of the exhibition. The six project-focused events will bring together centrally administered state-owned enterprises, multinational companies, companies with investment from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan, businesses backed by overseas Chinese investors, and privately owned manufacturers. They will include a partnership event for Chinese private-sector manufacturers, a business-matching program connecting multinational companies with Anhui's emerging industries, a forum promoting cooperation between Anhui and Taiwan in complementary sectors, and a project-matching event for overseas Chinese entrepreneurs. The convention will also partner with leading think tanks and research institutions, including the National Manufacturing Strategy Advisory Committee, the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology and the China Electronics Standardization Institute. Jointly organized programs will include the 2026 Forum on Building China into a Manufacturing Powerhouse, an event focused on the digital and intelligent transformation of manufacturing, and a forum on innovative approaches to smart manufacturing standardization. Several related industry events will take place elsewhere in Anhui during the convention. Wuhu will host the 2026 Low-Altitude Economy Development Conference; Chuzhou will stage a business and technology-matching event showcasing advances in photovoltaics and next-generation energy storage; and Tongling will host the China Copper Processing Industry Annual Conference together with the China (Tongling) Conference on High-Quality Development of the Copper Industry. Anhui enters this year's convention with a rapidly expanding industrial economy. Among businesses in the province's industrial sector with annual revenue of at least RMB 20 million, combined revenue has risen from RMB 3.8 trillion to RMB 5.9 trillion, moving Anhui from 12th to fifth place nationwide. The province also ranks fifth nationally on an index measuring the high-quality development of manufacturing, firmly establishing it as one of China's major industrial centers. The exhibition—traditionally one of the convention's principal attractions—will occupy 70,000 square meters, according to the Anhui Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology. A 20,000-square-meter exhibition devoted to manufacturing development and innovation will comprise 10 themed zones. These will include an introductory pavilion, a showcase of China's manufacturing capabilities, a guest province pavilion, an international pavilion, a smart and connected vehicle zone, and a robotics and embodied AI zone. A further 50,000 square meters of commercially operated exhibition space will be divided into five industry-specific zones covering areas such as automotive supply chains and semiconductors, as well as artificial intelligence and robotics. More than 900 companies have been selected to participate, with over 10,000 items expected to be on display. Luogang Park will host a separate interactive showcase devoted to integrated unmanned systems operating across air, ground and other environments. Outdoor displays will include demonstrations of unmanned aircraft and autonomous vehicles.
